dimensions.detail: SKILL.md explicitly requires OpenClaw built‑in browser automation and states the browser session will inherit the user's logged‑in state. llm.guidance: This skill appears to do what it says: it scrapes reviews through the OpenClaw built‑in browser and analyzes them with Python. Before installing or invoking it, consider the following: 1) the skill requires use of the platform's browser automation and will inherit your logged‑in session—only run it if you trust the skill and are comfortable exposing account‑visible pages; 2) it suggests pip installing packages at runtime—prefer reviewing and pinning package versions or installing them in an isolated environment; 3) test on a non‑production account or a sample dataset first to confirm no unexpected data is accessed or transmitted; 4) if you need stronger assurance, ask the publisher for source code or a detailed workflow that shows exactly which pages are accessed and that no external endpoints are contacted. If you want, I can list the specific questions to ask the skill author or produce a safe checklist to run before first use.
